verdict.rationale: Mercury's docs explicitly document sending payments to recipients via ACH, check, domestic wire, and international wire, with optional approval controls (mercury-docs-46, mercury-docs-53), plus dashboard-based payment approval permissions for accountants/finance leads (mercury-docs-11) and request-to-send-money approval flows (mercury-docs-55). Community evidence corroborates reliable wire transfers over years of use (mercury-comm-1). Missing for 10: independent third-party verification specifically of ACH/domestic-wire vendor payments (beyond general wire reliability), and more detail on vendor-specific workflows (e.g., recipient management UI) rather than API/product docs alone.
